card.title: Galaxy Z Fold 4 5g not powering on, not charging, and/or bootlooping

source.title: Galaxy Z Fold 4 5g not powering on, not charging, and/or bootlooping

symptoms: works only when folded or unfolded

claims.statement: Symptoms that change when a Galaxy Z Fold 4 is opened or closed (bootloop, no charge, ~0.2 A fake charging, no power) usually come from a damaged hinge flex.
claims.evidence: Problem description; applies to many folding phones.

claims.statement: A new hinge flex can be plugged in without installing it to confirm the diagnosis; dry-fitting also enables data recovery.
Replacing only the hinge flex requires removing the fragile inner OLED; an in-frame inner display comes with the flex preinstalled and is lower risk but expensive.
For bootloops, flash firmware via download mode using HOME_CSC to keep data, and try safe mode to rule out software.

procedure: Dry-fit a new hinge flex to confirm.
For charge-only issues test the port with a USB-C tester or known-good port and test both batteries.
For bootloops try safe mode and a HOME_CSC firmware flash.
Choose data-only recovery (dry fit), in-frame inner display, or inner display removal and flex swap.
Avoid crimping the new flex under the hinge shield; reflash if updated while faulty.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Removing the inner display risks tearing the OLED panel and its flex cables.
SOURCE RISK: Use HOME_CSC, not CSC, in Odin unless data loss is acceptable.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
